definition: Gold recall = hits / qrel count. nDCG = discounted graded gain / ideal gain.
required_data: Qrels and ranks
limitations: Report binary gains with sparse qrels. Do not score the unordered union as a ranked list.

definition: Newly staged qrel ids in batch / eligible gold count. Also report raw novel count.
required_data: Ordered batches and per-query top K
feasibility: B for archived ranks; D for exact missing live ranks
limitations: Shared pre-batch state. Attribute overlapping additions to the batch.

definition: Gold or evidence ids in union through j slots / eligible labeled ids.
required_data: Query text manifest and ranks
limitations: Match K and plot against both slots and unique workspace size.

metric: Exact repeat rate and lexical diversity
definition: Repeat occurrences / all occurrences after normalization. Optional mean pairwise token Jaccard distance.
required_data: Ordered subqueries
limitations: Repeated query can serve a new scope. Diversity alone rewards drift.

definition: Double-code anchor additions, constraint changes, topic drift and follow-up context.
required_data: Questions, ordered queries, prior outputs, codebook
literature: How AI agents search; TREC Session Track
limitations: Longer queries are not necessarily better. Include identifiable clue reuse.

definition: Paired change in future gain, success and cost with prior span present versus controlled replacement.
required_data: Matched continuations with same model and budget
limitations: Static query comparison cannot identify effect of observing a clue.

definition: Novel gold hits / j query slots or actual retrieval seconds, alongside cumulative gain.
required_data: Ranks, joined calls and trustworthy timing
feasibility: B for slots; D for unavailable timing decomposition
limitations: Macro-average per question or label micro weighting. Tail steps are selectively observed.

definition: Intersection of final workspace and qrel set / eligible qrel set. Keep gold and evidence separate.
required_data: Workspace list, pinned corpus IDs, qrels
limitations: Incomplete qrels. Report denominator and paired changes.

definition: Indicator for nonempty intersection or full inclusion of eligible G.
required_data: Inventories and qrels
limitations: All gold is neither necessary nor sufficient for passage-level support.

definition: Qrel hits / unique staged files; expansion = size of W_after minus W_before.
required_data: Final inventories and per-batch growth or archived rankings
feasibility: A final; B replay; D exact live additions
limitations: Unjudged is unknown. Compare at matched candidate budgets.

definition: Duplicate IDs before union / staged inputs. Useful observed text tokens / observed body tokens if measured.
required_data: Ranked arrivals, normalized spans, tokenizer and labels
feasibility: B rank proxy; C spans; D missing payload
limitations: Separate repeated IDs from semantic duplicates and labeled density from truly relevant density.

definition: Covered adjudicated clue groups / required groups for a valid evidence route.
required_data: Manifest, corpus, alternative span annotations
limitations: Span in workspace establishes opportunity. Account for acceptable alternative evidence routes.

definition: Report indexing time and size separately from online ranker time and staging time.
required_data: Build logs and per-action telemetry
limitations: Amortize with explicit workload. Wall time mixes pipeline components.

metric: Gold path and successful gold access
definition: Fraction with attributable path or body access respectively. Require linked source and actual body text for access.
required_data: Tool trace, path map, corpus and qrels
limitations: Preview and title are visibilities, not body. Any-source passage can bypass a separate read.

definition: Unique eligible leads with subsequent same-source body access by h decisions / eligible visible leads.
required_data: Path sightings, timestamps/order, valid reads
limitations: Same batch cannot establish dependence. Report terminal leads and direct-shell evidence.

definition: Fraction of all questions with verified sufficient or decisive evidence by decision t, with unresolved bounds.
required_data: Ordered observations, provenance and span labels
limitations: Retain stopped runs. Success-only medians hide failures.

definition: Report repeat span overlap and explicit malformed, zero-hit, timed-out and clipped actions separately.
required_data: Trace outputs, offsets and errors
feasibility: B for explicit events; C genuine waste
limitations: Zero hits can refute a hypothesis. Clipping is not proof of wasted effort.

definition: Any verified decisive span exposure and any verified complete sufficient set before final response.
required_data: Attributable model-visible spans and double-coded clues
feasibility: A prior decisive labels; C validated sufficiency
limitations: Gold path, body text and answer mention are distinct. Record conflict and uncertainty.

definition: Verified matched span groups / required groups. Precision = relevant exposed groups / judged exposed groups.
required_data: Mapped spans and bounded relevance labels
limitations: Denominator must match labeling scope. Unjudged text cannot count as irrelevant.

definition: Direct judgment of entailment by observed spans. Citation entailment rate only if outputs cite.
required_data: Exact answer and observed text; citations when applicable
limitations: Support is observable. Actual evidence use is unidentifiable from text alone.

definition: Judge correct / all questions; correct and sufficient / sufficient with uncertainty tallied.
required_data: Matched verdicts and sufficiency annotations
limitations: Keep same judge and report joint counts. Conditioning can select distinct questions by arm.

definition: Count model decisions and tool calls by family, sum recorded tokens, report elapsed seconds and coverage.
required_data: Turn/call fields and retry metadata
literature: RISE; Is Grep All You Need?
limitations: Match budgets and tokenizer. Tool-call count is interface-dependent and wall time mixes load.

definition: Plot success and verified evidence across common budgets; cost per successful answer = total measured cost / correct answers.
required_data: Verdicts, usage, budgeted observations
feasibility: B recorded usage; D comparable pricing or extra runs
limitations: Do not infer final accuracy of a forced early stop from exposure alone.

metric: Paired transition, attrition and coverage-exposure gap
definition: Report both-arm success and discordances; same-source transition = passed A and B / passed A. Separate unknowns.
required_data: Matched stage and provenance data
limitations: Differences between nonnested marginals are descriptive. Never force an any-source path into a gold-only funnel.

definition: Code earliest verified missed opportunity or observed failure and preserve competing explanations.
required_data: Complete enough trace and adjudicated clue/answer labels
limitations: One trace can contain multiple mechanisms. Missing records do not imply failure.
